g.text: Predicted pad limit surface from unit bench tests
Terminal-detachment command · 0.5 N unit steps · 3 s dwell · 10 N unit preload
Characteristic prediction: identical engaged units, equal stiffness, first-unit terminal failure. This is not a measured pad boundary or a pad reliability quantile.
Interpolation stays inside the tested unit-force domain; the plotted force range is not an ultimate shear limit.
